feature: Analysis tab, PR D: the header band and the bracket chip
note: The deck header's order (name, pips and commander, then a chips row carrying the status pill and the bracket chip, then the bar), and the handoff chip on both mounts (Analysis tab handoff §1; audit findings 3 and 4). Needs the same decks as analysis-tab.json: ANALYSIS_DECK (a single bracket), ANALYSIS_SPLIT_DECK (a range left unanswered) and ANALYSIS_EMPTY_DECK (no stored reading, so the pill stands alone). The header draws on load, so no row presses anything.

rows.label: /decks/[id] header: a single bracket, one 22px mark and the name, beside the status pill
/decks/[id] header: a range asked, two marks (the high one dimmed) and `{low} or {high}`
/decks/[id] header: no reading, so the status pill stands alone in the chips row
/decks: the tile draws the same chip in its footer
